sloka: जीवितं त्यक्तुमिच्छामि शोकेन महता वृता ।राक्षसीभिश्च रक्षन्त्या रामो नासाद्यते मया ।। ५.२३.१९।।।।
transliteration: jīvitaṁ tyaktumicchāmi śokena mahatā vṛtā ।rākṣasībhiśca rakṣantyā rāmo nāsādyate mayā ।। 5.23.19।।।।

translations.english: 'O lady of beautiful brows why don't you make up your mind to accept the king of kings, afraid of whom the trees rain flowers, the mountains and clouds release water at his will? Ravana is the king of the southwest, direction Why don't you wish to be his wife?
